properties.description: In a temporary repository with a saved design: branch A adds a requirement and edits capability X, and branch B adds a decision and edits capability Y, each exporting once or several times. Merge A, then merge B with `git merge` and NO merge driver configured (as GitHub does). PASS: no conflict, and the merged design holds every change from both sides. A control where both branches edit the SAME property of the same node must produce a conflict on exactly that one item file. Reproduces #571's second and third CI failures, which today conflict on the whole file every time. Must fail on the current single-file export before it is trusted.
properties.findings: 2026-10-03 (chg:the-design-is-saved-one-file-per-item-2026-10-03): tools/test_item_layout_merges.py on the real binary, real git branches, no merge driver configured. test_two_prs_with_records_and_fragments_merge_in_either_order_with_no_conflict: two PRs, each with a design record (2 and 3 exports) and a CHANGELOG fragment, land in both orders by merge commit and by squash with zero conflicts and one identical tree; `--diff` (compare_designs) reads the merge identical to a sequential replay of both records, same content hash; the merge imports cleanly. test_the_same_property_changed_on_both_sides_conflicts_on_that_one_item: exactly one unmerged path, that capability's item file. test_the_single_file_export_conflicts_where_the_layout_does_not: the same disjoint changes on a single-file export conflict on it (the control the check asked to fail first).
properties.name: Two branches that change disjoint parts of the design merge with plain git, no custom driver, no conflict
